threepl.exec

Class PipeRefs.SetPair

  • java.lang.Object
    • threepl.exec.PipeRefs.SetPair
  • Enclosing class:
    PipeRefs

    public class PipeRefs.SetPair
extends java.lang.Object
    This class holds a pair of sets representing an availability expression. The set in field pipes is a set of pipe variables. The set in field sigs is a set of TDEVar conditional signals. The class represents the logical product of the elements in both sets. Instances of this set are stored in another set, field read_ands in class PipeRefs, which represents products to be ORed.
